dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: Shhh! Don't let anyone else hear! I'm only telling you, alright!?

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: A kind Carp Adeptus awakened recently, saw the damage in Chenyu Vale, and stopped the Xuanwen Beasts from wreaking more havoc.

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: If that rumor's true, the quality of tea will return to normal soon, easy!

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: Maybe it'll even be better than before!
